newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT- Lehman cuts BT estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Lehman cuts BT estimates.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Tuesday it had reduced earnings estimates for British Telecommunications Plc, which is expected to suffer increased costs as a result of the UK budget.
Analyst Paul Norris downgraded pretax profit forecasts to 3.1 billion for the current year from 3.5 billion previously. For 1998/9, estimates were cut to 3.2 billion stg from 3.6 billion stg.
Forecasts for earnings per share were cut by nine percent for the current year and 10 percent for the following year.
Norris said in a research note that pension fund contributions, net interest payments and redundancy payments were all expected to rise as a result of last week's budget.
He said BT's associate losses were also climbing more steeply than anticipated and Concert earnings were expected to suffer from the stronger sterling-dollar exchange rate.
Lehman retains its "outperform" rating but remains cautious in the short term after a dramatic twelve percent climb in the share price last week.
BT was down 3-1/2p to 488p by 1041 GMT.
